The '''electrogate''' was the only way to leave [[Mos Shuuta/Legends|Mos Shuuta]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] with a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]]. It was usually guarded by four [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] working for [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]].
